Review written to `.sdlc/runs/20261105-000000-feature-new-rich-text-spans/review.json` (`verdict: "needs_changes"`).

### Findings
- **Blocker** — `packages/excalidraw/tests/textStyleRanges.test.tsx:51`: `createStyledText` types `overrides` as `Partial<ExcalidrawTextElement>`, which includes readonly metadata keys (`id`, `version`, `versionNonce`, `updated`) rejected by `ElementUpdate<NonDeleted<ExcalidrawTextElement>>` in `newElementWith` (TS2345).
- **Major** — `packages/excalidraw/tests/textStyleRanges.test.tsx:78`: `executeAction` for `actionChangeStrokeColor` and `actionChangeBackgroundColor` passes `{ currentItemStrokeColor }` / `{ currentItemBackgroundColor }` instead of `{ color }`, so `perform` returns early without updating `textStyleRanges` while the test only checks `Array.isArray(current.textStyleRanges)`, and the `// undo/redo` block at line 227 never executes `Keyboard.undo()` or `Keyboard.redo()`.

### Passing Checks
- **Correctness & Data Model** (`packages/element/src/types.ts`, `textStyleRanges.ts`, `newElement.ts`, `duplicate.ts`, `transform.ts`, `delta.ts`, `restore.ts`, `clipboard.ts`): Pure interval decomposition, edit shifting, wrapped-line run mapping, and lifecycle cloning/normalisation match `change_plan.md`.
- **Rendering & Export** (`packages/element/src/renderElement.ts`, `packages/excalidraw/renderer/staticSvgScene.ts`): Canvas 2D highlight/glyph passes and SVG `<rect>`/`<tspan>` export preserve the unstyled fast path and apply dark-mode filtering.
- **WYSIWYG & Actions** (`packages/excalidraw/wysiwyg/textWysiwyg.tsx`, `App.text.ts`, `colorTargets.ts`, `actionProperties.tsx`): Selection tracking excludes untouched mount auto-select, preserves selection across properties panel interactions, and routes inline stroke/background updates to `textStyleRanges`.
